title: सप्तचत्वारिंशदधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Mudgala asks the messenger about the joys and the faults of heaven, and learns that merit there runs out and the fallen suffer bitterly. He declines heaven and, devoting himself to meditation, attains the supreme abode beyond it; Vyasa urges Yudhishthira to bear his sorrow and departs.
summary.kn: ಸ್ವರ್ಗದ ಸುಖಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ದೋಷಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಮುದ್ಗಲನು ದೂತನನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ, ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಪುಣ್ಯ ಮುಗಿಯುವುದು ಬಿದ್ದವರು ಕಹಿಯಾಗಿ ನರಳುವರು ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸ್ವರ್ಗವನ್ನು ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿ ಧ್ಯಾನನಿರತನಾಗಿ ಅದನ್ನು ಮೀರಿದ ಪರಮಪದವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ; ದುಃಖ ಸಹಿಸೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳಿ ವ್ಯಾಸರು ತೆರಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: मुद्गल दूत से स्वर्ग के सुखों और दोषों के बारे में पूछते हैं, और जानते हैं कि वहाँ पुण्य समाप्त हो जाता है और गिरने वाले कटु दुःख पाते हैं। वे स्वर्ग अस्वीकार कर ध्यान में लीन होकर उससे परे परमपद पाते हैं; व्यास युधिष्ठिर से शोक सहने को कहकर विदा होते हैं।
summary.te: స్వర్గపు సుఖాలు, దోషాల గురించి ముద్గలుడు దూతను అడిగి, అక్కడ పుణ్యం తరిగిపోతుందని, పడినవారు తీవ్రంగా బాధపడతారని తెలుసుకుంటాడు. స్వర్గాన్ని నిరాకరించి ధ్యాననిరతుడై దానికి అతీతమైన పరమపదాన్ని పొందుతాడు; దుఃఖాన్ని సహించమని యుధిష్ఠిరునికి చెప్పి వ్యాసుడు వెళ్తాడు.
summary.ta: ஸ்வர்க்கத்தின் இன்பங்களையும் குறைகளையும் பற்றி முத்கலர் தூதனிடம் கேட்டு, அங்குப் புண்ணியம் தீர்ந்துவிடும், வீழ்வோர் கடுமையாகத் துன்புறுவர் என்று அறிகிறார். ஸ்வர்க்கத்தை மறுத்துத் தியானத்தில் ஆழ்ந்து அதைக் கடந்த பரமபதத்தை அடைகிறார்; துயரைப் பொறுக்குமாறு யுதிஷ்டிரரிடம் சொல்லி வியாசர் புறப்படுகிறார்.
summary.ml: സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിലെ സുഖങ്ങളെയും ദോഷങ്ങളെയും കുറിച്ച് മുദ്ഗലൻ ദൂതനോട് ചോദിക്കുന്നു; അവിടെ പുണ്യം തീർന്നുപോകുമെന്നും വീണവർ കഠിനമായി കഷ്ടപ്പെടുമെന്നും അദ്ദേഹം അറിയുന്നു. സ്വർഗ്ഗം നിരസിച്ച് ധ്യാനത്തിൽ മുഴുകിയ അദ്ദേഹം അതിനുമപ്പുറമുള്ള പരമധാമം പ്രാപിക്കുന്നു; ദുഃഖം സഹിക്കാൻ യുധിഷ്ഠിരനെ ഉപദേശിച്ച് വ്യാസൻ പോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.247; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: देवदूत उवाच

meaning.en: The messenger of the gods said:

verses.text:
महर्षेऽकार्यबुद्धिस्त्वं यः स्वर्गसुखमुत्तमम् ।
संप्राप्तं बहु मन्तव्यं विमृशस्यबुधो यथा ॥

meaning.en: Great sage, your judgment is faulty: having reached the supreme joy of heaven, a thing to be prized, you hesitate like a fool.

verses.text:
उपरिष्टादसौ लोको योऽयं स्वरिति संज्ञितः ।
ऊर्ध्वगः सत्पथः शश्वद्देवयानचरो मुने ॥

meaning.en: Above us lies the world called Svar. It leads upward, a path of the good, on which the gods travel, sage.

verses.text:
नातप्ततपसः पुंसो नामहायज्ञयाजिनः ।
नानृता नास्तिकाश्चैव तत्र गच्छन्ति मुद्गल ॥

meaning.en: Men who have not practiced austerity, who have not performed great sacrifices, liars and unbelievers do not go there, Mudgala.

verses.text:
धर्मात्मानो जितात्मानः शान्ता दान्ता विमत्सराः ।
दानधर्मरताः पुंसः शूराश्चाहतलक्षणाः ॥

meaning.en: Righteous men, self-controlled, peaceful, restrained, free of envy, devoted to giving, and brave men of known marks go there.

verses.text:
तत्र गच्छन्ति कर्माग्र्यं कृत्वा शमदमात्मकम् ।
लोकान्पुण्यकृतां ब्रह्मन्सद्भिरासेवितान्नृभिः ॥

meaning.en: They go there after performing the highest rites of peace and self-control, to the worlds of the virtuous, brahmin, frequented by good men.

verses.text:
देवाः साध्यास्तथा विश्वे मरुतश्च महर्षिभिः ।
यामा धामाश्च मौद्गल्य गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: The gods, Sadhyas, Vishvedevas and Maruts with great sages, the Yamas, the Dhamas, the Gandharvas and apsaras, Mudgala,

verses.text:
एषां देवनिकायानां पृथक्पृथगनेकशः ।
भास्वन्तः कामसंपन्ना लोकास्तेजोमयाः शुभाः ॥

meaning.en: each of these classes of gods has its own shining worlds, full of every desire, radiant and bright.

verses.text:
त्रयस्त्रिंशत्सहस्राणि योजनानां हिरण्मयः ।
मेरुः पर्वतराड्यत्र देवोद्यानानि मुद्गल ॥

meaning.en: There stands golden Meru, king of mountains, thirty-three thousand yojanas high, where the gods' gardens are, Mudgala.

verses.text:
नन्दनादीनि पुण्यानि विहाराः पुण्यकर्मणाम् ।
न क्षुत्पिपासे न ग्लानिर्न शीतोष्णभयं तथा ॥

meaning.en: There are holy places like Nandana, pleasure grounds of the virtuous. There is no hunger, thirst, weariness, fear of cold or heat,

verses.text:
बीभत्समशुभं वापि रोगा वा तत्र केचन ।
मनोज्ञाः सर्वतो गन्धाः सुखस्पर्शाश्च सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: nothing ugly or inauspicious, and no diseases. All scents are pleasing, all touches soft,

verses.text:
शब्दाः श्रुतिमनोग्राह्याः सर्वतस्तत्र वै मुने ।
न शोको न जरा तत्र नायासपरिदेवने ॥

meaning.en: and sounds delight the ear and mind on every side, sage. There is no grief, no old age, no toil or lamenting.

verses.text:
ईदृशः स मुने लोकः स्वकर्मफलहेतुकः ।
सुकृतैस्तत्र पुरुषाः संभवन्त्यात्मकर्मभिः ॥

meaning.en: Such is that world, sage, the result of one's own deeds. People are born there by their own good deeds.

verses.text:
तैजसानि शरीराणि भवन्त्यत्रोपपद्यताम् ।
कर्मजान्येव मौद्गल्य न मातृपितृजान्युत ॥

meaning.en: Bodies there are made of light, born of deeds alone, not of mother and father, Mudgala.

verses.text:
न च स्वेदो न दौर्गन्ध्यं पुरीषं मूत्रमेव च ।
तेषां न च रजो वस्त्रं बाधते तत्र वै मुने ॥

meaning.en: There is no sweat, no bad smell, no excrement or urine, and no dust troubles their clothes, sage.

verses.text:
न म्लायन्ति स्रजस्तेषां दिव्यगन्धा मनोरमाः ।
पर्युह्यन्ते विमानैश्च ब्रह्मन्नेवंविधाश्च ते ॥

meaning.en: Their garlands of heavenly fragrance, charming, never wither. They are carried about in celestial cars, brahmin, such are they.

verses.text:
ईर्ष्याशोकक्लमापेता मोहमात्सर्यवर्जिताः ।
सुखं स्वर्गजितस्तत्र वर्तयन्ति महामुने ॥

meaning.en: Free of jealousy, grief and weariness, without delusion or envy, great sage, they live in happiness, conquerors of heaven.

verses.text:
तेषां तथाविधानां तु लोकानां मुनिपुंगव ।
उपर्युपरि शक्रस्य लोका दिव्यगुणान्विताः ॥

meaning.en: Above those worlds, best of sages, are the worlds of Indra, endowed with divine qualities.

verses.text:
पुरस्ताद्ब्रह्मणस्तत्र लोकास्तेजोमयाः शुभाः ।
यत्र यान्त्यृषयो ब्रह्मन्पूताः स्वैः कर्मभिः शुभैः ॥

meaning.en: Beyond them lie the radiant and auspicious worlds of Brahma, to which sages go, purified by their own good deeds.

verses.text:
ऋभवो नाम तत्रान्ये देवानामपि देवताः ।
तेषां लोकाः परतरे तान्यजन्तीह देवताः ॥

meaning.en: There are others called the Ribhus, gods even of the gods. Their worlds lie further on, and the gods here worship them.

verses.text:
स्वयंप्रभास्ते भास्वन्तो लोकाः कामदुघाः परे ।
न तेषां स्त्रीकृतस्तापो न लोकैश्वर्यमत्सरः ॥

meaning.en: Those self-luminous, shining worlds fulfill every wish; they have no pain from women, no jealousy over worldly lordship.

verses.text:
न वर्तयन्त्याहुतिभिस्ते नाप्यमृतभोजनाः ।
तथा दिव्यशरीरास्ते न च विग्रहमूर्तयः ॥

meaning.en: They live not by oblations and do not eat ambrosia; their bodies are divine, and without fixed form.

verses.text:
न सुखे सुखकामाश्च देवदेवाः सनातनाः ।
न कल्पपरिवर्तेषु परिवर्तन्ति ते तथा ॥

meaning.en: They do not seek pleasure in pleasure, those eternal gods of gods; they do not change with the turnings of the ages.

verses.text:
जरा मृत्युः कुतस्तेषां हर्षः प्रीतिः सुखं न च ।
न दुःखं न सुखं चापि रागद्वेषौ कुतो मुने ॥

meaning.en: How could old age or death affect them, or joy, love or pleasure? No sorrow, no pleasure, no desire or hatred, sage.

verses.text:
देवानामपि मौद्गल्य काङ्क्षिता सा गतिः परा ।
दुष्प्रापा परमा सिद्धिरगम्या कामगोचरैः ॥

meaning.en: That supreme state is longed for even by the gods, Mudgala; it is hard to reach, the highest perfection, unreachable by those who follow desire.

verses.text:
त्रयस्त्रिंशदिमे लोकाः शेषा लोका मनीषिभिः ।
गम्यन्ते नियमैः श्रेष्ठैर्दानैर्वा विधिपूर्वकैः ॥

meaning.en: These are thirty-three worlds; the rest are reached by the wise through the best disciplines or gifts given properly.

verses.text:
सेयं दानकृता व्युष्टिरत्र प्राप्ता सुखावहा ।
तां भुङ्क्ष्व सुकृतैर्लब्धां तपसा द्योतितप्रभः ॥

meaning.en: This reward made by your giving has come to you and brings happiness. Enjoy it, won by your good deeds, shining with the glow of austerity.

verses.text:
एतत्स्वर्गसुखं विप्र लोका नानाविधास्तथा ।
गुणाः स्वर्गस्य प्रोक्तास्ते दोषानपि निबोध मे ॥

meaning.en: This is the pleasure of heaven, brahmin, and the many worlds. I have told you heaven's merits; now hear its faults.

verses.text:
कृतस्य कर्मणस्तत्र भुज्यते यत्फलं दिवि ।
न चान्यत्क्रियते कर्म मूलच्छेदेन भुज्यते ॥

meaning.en: There the fruit of a deed done is consumed, and no new deed is done; it is enjoyed until the root is cut.

verses.text:
सोऽत्र दोषो मम मतस्तस्यान्ते पतनं च यत् ।
सुखव्याप्तमनस्कानां पतनं यच्च मुद्गल ॥

meaning.en: That I count a fault here, and the fall at its end, Mudgala, and the fall of those whose minds were drenched with pleasure.

verses.text:
असंतोषः परीतापो दृष्ट्वा दीप्ततराः श्रियः ।
यद्भवत्यवरे स्थाने स्थितानां तच्च दुष्करम् ॥

meaning.en: There is discontent and torment on seeing brighter fortunes, and it is hard for those who stand in a lower place.

verses.text:
संज्ञामोहश्च पततां रजसा च प्रधर्षणम् ।
प्रम्लानेषु च माल्येषु ततः पिपतिषोर्भयम् ॥

meaning.en: Those who fall lose awareness and are overcome by passion; and when their garlands fade, the fear of falling comes.

verses.text:
आ ब्रह्मभवनादेते दोषा मौद्गल्य दारुणाः ।
नाकलोके सुकृतिनां गुणास्त्वयुतशो नृणाम् ॥

meaning.en: These fearful faults, Mudgala, extend up to Brahma's abode; in heaven there are myriads of merits for virtuous men.

verses.text:
अयं त्वन्यो गुणः श्रेष्ठश्च्युतानां स्वर्गतो मुने ।
शुभानुशययोगेन मनुष्येषूपजायते ॥

meaning.en: But there is another excellent merit for those who fall from heaven, sage: by the force of remaining good results, they are born among humans.

verses.text:
तत्रापि सुमहाभागः सुखभागभिजायते ।
न चेत्संबुध्यते तत्र गच्छत्यधमतां ततः ॥

meaning.en: Even there one is born very fortunate and share in happiness; but if one does not awake there, one goes lower from there.

verses.text:
इह यत्क्रियते कर्म तत्परत्रोपभुज्यते ।
कर्मभूमिरियं ब्रह्मन्फलभूमिरसौ मता ॥

meaning.en: The deed done here is enjoyed in the next world. This is the land of action, brahmin, and that the land of fruit.

verses.text:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां पृच्छसि मुद्गल ।
तवानुकम्पया साधो साधु गच्छाम माचिरम् ॥

meaning.en: I have told you all you ask, Mudgala. By your kindness, good man, let us go without delay."

verses.text: व्यास उवाच

meaning.en: Vyasa said:

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु मौद्गल्यो वाक्यं विममृशे धिया ।
विमृश्य च मुनिश्रेष्ठो देवदूतमुवाच ह ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this, Mudgala reflected on it in his mind, and having reflected, the best of sages said to the messenger of the gods:

verses.text:
देवदूत नमस्तेऽस्तु गच्छ तात यथासुखम् ।
महादोषेण मे कार्यं न स्वर्गेण सुखेन वा ॥

meaning.en: "Messenger, I bow to you; go, dear one, as you please. I want no heaven or pleasure that comes with great faults.

verses.text:
पतनं तन्महद्दुःखं परितापः सुदारुणः ।
स्वर्गभाजश्च्यवन्तीह तस्मात्स्वर्गं न कामये ॥

meaning.en: The fall is great misery and the torment is dreadful. Those who enjoy heaven fall from it here; so I do not want heaven.

verses.text:
यत्र गत्वा न शोचन्ति न व्यथन्ति चलन्ति वा ।
तदहं स्थानमत्यन्तं मार्गयिष्यामि केवलम् ॥

meaning.en: I will seek only that final place, going to which one does not grieve, is not pained, and does not stir."

verses.text:
इत्युक्त्वा स मुनिर्वाक्यं देवदूतं विसृज्य तम् ।
शिलोञ्छवृत्तिमुत्सृज्य शममातिष्ठदुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Saying this, the sage dismissed the messenger, gave up his life of gleaning grain and took up the highest peace.

verses.text:
तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्भूत्वा समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ।
ज्ञानयोगेन शुद्धेन ध्याननित्यो बभूव ह ॥

meaning.en: Treating blame and praise alike, clod, stone and gold alike, he became constant in meditation through pure knowledge and discipline.

verses.text:
ध्यानयोगाद्बलं लब्ध्वा प्राप्य चर्द्धिमनुत्तमाम् ।
जगाम शाश्वतीं सिद्धिं परां निर्वाणलक्षणाम् ॥

meaning.en: Gaining strength through meditation and reaching the highest prosperity, he attained eternal perfection, the supreme, marked by liberation.

verses.text:
तस्मात्त्वमपि कौन्तेय न शोकं कर्तुमर्हसि ।
राज्यात्स्फीतात्परिभ्रष्टस्तपसा तदवाप्स्यसि ॥

meaning.en: So you also, son of Kunti, should not grieve. Though you have fallen from a prosperous kingdom, by austerity you will regain it.

verses.text:
सुखस्यानन्तरं दुःखं दुःखस्यानन्तरं सुखम् ।
पर्यायेणोपवर्तन्ते नरं नेमिमरा इव ॥

meaning.en: After happiness comes sorrow and after sorrow, happiness; they turn in succession for a man like spokes around the rim of a wheel.

verses.text:
पितृपैतामहं राज्यं प्राप्स्यस्यमितविक्रम ।
वर्षात्त्रयोदशादूर्ध्वं व्येतु ते मानसो ज्वरः ॥

meaning.en: You of boundless valor will regain your father's and grandfather's kingdom after the thirteenth year; let the fever of your mind pass."

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान्व्यासः पाण्डवनन्दनम् ।
जगाम तपसे धीमान्पुनरेवाश्रमं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Having said this to the delight of the Pandavas, the revered, wise Vyasa went back to his hermitage to practice austerity.
